basketball_evidence_retrospective.pre_tip_hypothesis: Initial DEN LOW against frozen HOU 56.59%, emphasizing potential missing Şengün/Adams/Capela and Jokić/Murray orchestration; explicitly stated DEN edge weaker if Şengün played, and Rockets offensive rebounding as counterargument.
basketball_evidence_retrospective.after: Denver won 133–124, but Şengün played 36:03 and posted 28 points, 11 rebounds, 10 assists; Steven Adams also played 11:57. Therefore pretip center-unavailability mechanism did NOT materialize as expected. Jokić scored 24 of 26 after halftime, Denver closed on a 23–9 run; game featured 32 lead changes. Accurate contrarian result is NOT proof initial absence mechanism was right. Full-game model total 230.67 vs 257 actual, 26.33 total MAE.

basketball_evidence_retrospective.pre_tip_hypothesis: Model favored CHI 64.39%, model fullgame total 239.62. Independent analyst abstained because Chicago transition vs Washington shot creation and uncertain rotations could reasonably go either way.
basketball_evidence_retrospective.after: Washington won 98–94. Anthony Davis 36/11 and AJ Dybantsa 20/10/6. Team shooting Chicago 36/88 overall, 9/33 from three (27.3%); Washington 40/90 FG, 9/17 FT. Combined just 192 points: 47.62 below forecast. Possessions and offensive efficiency require separate validation; do not assume total miss was solely slower pace. Outcome supports caution on winner, not a pretip UNDER pick.

basketball_evidence_retrospective.pre_tip_hypothesis: Frozen LAL 88.47%, expected +15.84; independent LAL MEDIUM, explicitly flagging Utah's prior suppression of Lakers, Luka turnovers and Sabonis/Acuff matchup.
basketball_evidence_retrospective.after: Los Angeles won just 106–104; Kings held an 11-point lead early second half. Luka 25/8 assists, De'Andre Hunter 30 for Sacramento, Sabonis 19/16; Grimes hit late tiebreaking three. Margin error 13.84 and total error 25.35 points. Strong winner probability does not guarantee large winning margin. Cup differential incentives cannot be asserted to have caused observed plays.

basketball_evidence_retrospective.pre_tip_hypothesis: Both chose DET with low analyst confidence, conditional on Cade's PROBABLE availability; pretip counterargument explicitly identified Barnes/Quickley/Poeltl exploiting DET's absent Duren and Robinson.
basketball_evidence_retrospective.after: Toronto won 105–102, Barnes 29 including go-ahead layup with 14s left; Cade played and supplied 23/9 assists. Realized Toronto offense and closing shot aligns with counter-case, but no isolated causal proof Duren absence cost game. Detroit's expected +7.34 versus actual −3: 10.34 margin error.

basketball_evidence_retrospective.pre_tip_hypothesis: Independent ORL MEDIUM, Franz Wagner/Bane halfcourt shot creation despite Banchero OUT and a Brooklyn frontcourt rebounding counter.
basketball_evidence_retrospective.after: Orlando held on 113–111 after Wagner's 35 points and a go-ahead jumper with 2.8 seconds remaining. Correct specific creator signal; narrow result also supports opponent counter-signal and says nothing certain about long-run clutch efficiency.

basketball_evidence_retrospective.pre_tip_hypothesis: SGA and Hartenstein support against Zion; confirmed absent OKC defensive players produced LOW analyst confidence despite model OKC 84.48%.
basketball_evidence_retrospective.after: OKC won 126–120, only six rather than model +13.17, as SGA scored 40 and rookie Aday Mara added 22/16. NOP Zion and Fears scored 22 each. Scoring production from Mara matters and should not be incorrectly attributed solely to Hartenstein.

limitations: Individual historical locked injury statuses are not silently replaced with actual active status. In Denver-Houston Şengün and Adams played, disproving the conditional missing-centers premise; postgame result alone cannot prove initial role mechanism.
All market odds from indexed aggregators remained unverified BEFORE tip; official graded O/U N/A, not an inferred Under after large total miss.
9 games and a single contrarian success do not justify changing frozen coefficients or asserting sustainable independent analyst outperformance. No production pointer alteration.
All 9 are Cup Group Play. Regulation point differential may matter to standings, but no game-specific upset/motivation coefficient was estimated or retrospectively assumed.
